about: The frame itself, shown around the simplest page there is (the reader): a route and its argument, the rail, its destinations, Circle closing it, and a picture drawn the way it was made.

boards.name: frame-route
boards.about: A route opens its screen with its argument; nothing moves once it is up.

boards.name: frame-rail-destination
boards.about: A destination of the rail replaces the whole stack and closes the rail.

boards.name: frame-rail-closed-by-circle
boards.about: Circle closes the rail and the page has the focus again.

boards.name: frame-picture-upright
boards.about: A decoded picture is drawn the way it was made: the probe's top half is red, its bottom half blue, its left edge green, on the second card (not focused, so nothing covers it) and in the hero's backdrop.
